record.title: Recover the remaining initialization grammar including transport branches
record.intent: Predict SCU UART GD32 LA and version consumers as one typed contract before extending runtime observation.
requirements: Pin the unchanged stock library and byte ranges supporting SCU and LA operands, mutable shadows, call bindings, branch order and status propagation.
Recover board-power UART open frame write close and fatal-write paths, GD32 cached descriptor and reopen selectors, hardware-version device reads and delegated setup semantics.
Classify nodes as static-determined runtime-selected hardware-returned asynchronous or unknown; preserve branches instead of asserting an unconditional flat transcript.
Derive a typed TOML graph and deterministic candidate operations with Kotlin tooling; check provenance and graph integrity independently of the producer.
Trace the first mapped version reads through their immediate consumers and identify where further recovery or returned state is required; do not invent FPGA or UART responses.

Compare syscall observation and native checkpoints for the transport region, including synchronization perturbation, thread coverage, deadlines and negative controls required before stock continuation.
acceptance: A reproducible static conclusion with explicit unknowns and runtime falsification boundaries is committed and pushed before observer implementation.
